title: Dilution and Amplification Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol performs a custom dilution and PCR protocol on the Opentrons Thermocycler GEN2 Module. The number of samples will be automatically calculated from the input cherrypicking .csv list, which should be formatted as the following example **excluding the positive control**: ``` A4,tc B4,tc C1,dil D1,dil B1,dil H12,dil ``` Note that the first value of each line should specify the well location, and the second value should specify whether to pick from the thermocycler plate or the dilution plate.
Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Prepare input CSV file
steps.instruction: Create a cherry‑picking .csv list (excluding the positive control) with each line formatted as `<well>,<source>` where the first value is the well location and the second value is either `tc` for the thermocycler plate or `dil` for the dilution plate. Example: `A4,tc B4,tc C1,dil D1,dil B1,dil H12,dil`.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package and unzip it if necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware definitions
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select the required .json labware files.

steps.title: Upload protocol script
steps.instruction: In the Protocol tab of the Opentrons App, upload the protocol file with a .py extension.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Place labware on the deck following the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the Opentrons App to calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette (refer to support articles for calibration tips).

steps.title: Execute the protocol
steps.instruction: Press the Run button to start the custom dilution and PCR protocol on the Opentrons Thermocycler GEN2 Module; the system will automatically calculate the number of samples from the CSV file.
